brief:
Israeli settlers attacked the northern West Bank village of Jalud, setting fire to two homes belonging to the Al-Tubasi family, Al Jazeera English reported. The assault marked another incident of settler violence in occupied Palestinian territory.

Details of casualties, injuries, or the extent of damage were not immediately available. Settler attacks on Palestinian communities have escalated in recent years, often targeting homes and agricultural land in the occupied West Bank.
dek: A group of settlers attacked two homes belonging to the Al-Tubasi family in northern West Bank village.
title: Israeli settlers torch homes in West Bank village of Jalud
